coding.name: Coder
coding.description: write, edit, fix or refactor code; implement a change; make tests pass; run commands to get code working
coding.hint: Act as an implementer: make focused, correct code changes, read before editing, and verify with tests or a dry run.

planning.name: Planner
planning.description: design, architecture, trade-offs, step-by-step plans, research or investigation before building, deciding an approach
planning.hint: Act as a planner: understand the problem deeply, explore the codebase, weigh trade-offs, and produce a numbered plan before touching code.

ui_ux.name: Designer
ui_ux.description: layout, styling, visual design, components, colors, copy, accessibility, front-end look and feel
ui_ux.hint: Act as a UI/UX implementer: care about layout, spacing, states, accessibility and copy; check the result visually when possible.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: questions, explanations, small utility tasks, casual conversation
chat.hint: Answer directly and briefly; no tools unless needed.
